title: Version 2 Responsive, Accessibility, and UI Acceptance Audit

observations: hide-below-380 responsive utility cleanly suppresses non-essential secondary actions, avoiding horizontal scrollbars.
Primary action buttons remain accessible with min 44px tap target.
Today view cards wrap cleanly without text truncation.
Standard mobile layout with bottom navigation bar displaying active icons and labels.
Touch targets meet 48dp Android accessibility guideline.
Bangla conjuncts and matras render clearly with 1.7 line height.
Full mobile layout with comfortably spaced lists and floating action button.
Virtual keyboard open simulation: bottom nav hides, modal footer stays pinned with position: sticky.

viewportsAudited.deviceTarget: Standard Android device (Google Pixel 7/8, Samsung Galaxy)
observations: Generous spacing for cards, routines, and note previews.
Touch targets exceed minimum thresholds; fast capture input is immediately focusable.
Responsive grid layout adapts Today view into multi-column cards.
Modal dialogs render as centered floating dialogs with max-width: 600px.
Expanded sidebar navigation with permanent labels and badges.
Dual-pane Library view with list on left and markdown editor on right.
Keyboard focus rings (2px solid) visible on all interactive elements.
